title: Leg Press
summary: A machine press for the quads and glutes, with no balance or lower-back demand.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for quads (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly quads total.
Library rating 0.6 for glutes (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly glutes total.
Library rating 0.5 for adductors (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly adductors total.

setup.text: Sit with your back flat against the pad and your feet about shoulder width apart on the platform.
Lower until your knees are deeply bent, without letting your lower back peel off the pad.

form_cues.cue: Lower until knees are deeply bent
Keep your lower back on the pad
Press without locking the knees hard
Stop the descent before your hips curl up off the seat.

mistakes.text: Letting the hips roll off the seat at the bottom.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds two or three ramp-up sets at rising loads before the first working set, unless that load is very light.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 6-10 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: One side at a time, Lower loading potential.

notes: Ratings, swap attributes and cues are the library model (modeled). An authored page will replace this one.
